fields.h_reports: none; independent researcher with no reporting line
fields.f_subject: Recode of the frontier safety frameworks in the Zenodo dataset (10.5281/zenodo.22004430) against the coding frame fixed on 2026-10-12. A keyword search returns the candidate passages; a language model proposes a code for each; the researcher accepts, changes or rejects every one
fields.f_periodby: the function: the researcher sets the snapshot date of the documents
fields.f_function: One researcher, independent, unpaid by any developer in the sample
fields.f_in: All frameworks in the dataset as published on the snapshot date; every code in the frame, including the added code capability_operationalized; the authority condition recorded as a separate code
fields.f_out: Framework versions published after the snapshot date; how any framework operates inside the developer; whether any framework works; other developer documents (model cards, system cards, blog posts)
fields.f_budget: None beyond a model subscription paid by the researcher
fields.f_readbyperson: every passage returned by the keyword search; 57 passages
fields.f_readbytool: the remainder of each document, searched by keyword and not read
fields.f_spotchecks: Calibration: all passages, coded by the researcher before the model is run; disagreement rate recorded
fields.f_tools: A keyword search over all seven documents with the term list from the first pass; a language model given the frozen frame as instruction and asked to propose one code per passage; a spreadsheet for the code log
fields.f_toolrel: The model is built by one of the developers whose framework is in the sample. Its output on that developer's own document is not neutral evidence
fields.f_verify: Every model-proposed code is read against the source passage by the researcher before acceptance. All passages are coded blind first, and the disagreement rate between blind codes and model-assisted codes is published with the recode. No second human coder is available; this is stated, not proxied. Passages that use other words for the same thing are not returned by the search and are not coded; the term list is published.
fields.r_0_h: Developers hold internal versions and practices that the published frameworks do not show. The recode reads what is published and claims nothing about the rest
fields.r_1_h: The sample is the frameworks public on the snapshot date. Developers without a published framework, and revisions after that date, are outside it. So are passages that use words not on the term list
fields.r_2_h: Developers revise frameworks in place, often without version numbers. The dataset records the snapshot date and keeps the copy coded
fields.r_3_h: Earlier versions are withdrawn from developer sites. Archived copies are used where they exist and their source is recorded
fields.r_4_h: Model-proposed codes carry an error rate. Every code is reviewed by the researcher; the calibration subset measures the residual disagreement
fields.r_5_h: A model built by one developer in the sample may read that developer's framework more favourably. Codes on that document are checked in full by hand
fields.r_6_h: The model's developer is a subject of the study. Its proposals on its own developer's document are treated as prompts to read, never as evidence
fields.r_7_h: The study reads documents. It has no access to how any framework is applied inside the developer, and makes no claim about that
fields.r_8_h: Each developer decides what its framework publishes. What a framework omits cannot be found by reading it; absence of a code means absence from the text
fields.r_9_h: No developer reviews the frame, the term list, the codes or the paper before publication
fields.f_struct: Unpaid by any developer in the sample; no employment or advisory relationship with any; right to publish
fields.f_oper: None: the same person fixed the frame, runs the coding and reads the result
fields.f_tooling: Model supplied by one of the subjects, on a subscription paid by the researcher
fields.f_decline: If blind codes and model-assisted codes disagree on more than 20% of the calibration passages, the recode is reported as not completed and the first-pass codes stand. If the frame or the term list changes during the pass, the pass stops and is re-registered before restarting

after.f_basis: Limits published in full: one researcher, no second coder. Keyword-first search, term list published; passages worded outside the list not coded. Model built by one of the subjects; its proposals treated as prompts, not evidence; every accepted code read against its passage. Calibration: all 57 passages across 7 documents were blind-coded before the model was run, as registered; 0 of 57 blind codes differed from the model-assisted code. Zero differences shows agreement between this coder and the model on these passages; it does not show that an independent coder would reproduce them, and a reader cannot distinguish full agreement from an unexercised review. The blind codes and the model proposals are both published. The condition in 8a was not met.
after.f_codesent: the public, via a post on the repository’s Discussions page (“Declarations”)
after.f_notsupport: Any claim that a second, independent coder would reproduce these codes. Any claim about passages the term list did not return. Any claim about how a framework is applied inside the developer, or whether it works. Any claim that the model’s proposals were correct beyond the 57 passages reviewed. Any claim that a reader of the paper can tell, from the paper alone, whether a given passage was coded wrong.
